placements.title: capability is redefined as rehearsed readiness, not declared or planned readiness
placements.frame: Does this expression treat a capability, procedure, or safeguard as real only once it has been actively rehearsed, versus as real simply because it exists or was planned?
placements.why: The directive setting a monthly cadence, the aphorism equating an unrehearsed rollback with no rollback at all, and the spec line codifying that cadence are three angles on one recurring subject: that operational capability only counts once it has been exercised. This is a theme future envelopes about drills, rehearsals, and preparedness will keep feeding (rehearsal-as-proof-of-capability), not a one-time fact — it names a standing criterion for what counts as 'having' a capability, distinct from any single measurement or event. The graph and strata are both empty for this repo, so nothing existing could plausibly hold this theme; it is minted standalone with no forced hub.
